name: 31794 · Tifton, GA
findings: ZIP 31794 (Tifton) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31794 (Tifton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 31794 (Tifton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 38% of the typical level).
